CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFFTP

CFFTP is an FTP client for your templates. Open a named connection once, use it for as many file and directory operations as you like, and close it when you are done. Every call reports how it went in the CFFTP structure.

Category

Internet protocols

Syntax

<CFFTP ACTION="action"
    SERVER="server"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    PORT="port"
    CONNECTION="name"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    STOPONERROR="Yes/No"
    DIRECTORY="directory"
    NAME="query_name"
    LOCALFILE="local_path"
    REMOTEFILE="remote_name"
    ITEM="item"
    EXISTING="old_name"
    NEW="new_name"
    FAILIFEXISTS="Yes/No"
    TRANSFERMODE="Binary"
    PASSIVE="Yes"
    PROXYSERVER="proxyserver"
    RETRYCOUNT="number"
    AGENTNAME="name">

Attributes

ACTION
Required. Open, Close, ChangeDir, CreateDir, RemoveDir, ListDir, GetFile, PutFile, Remove, Rename, GetCurrentDir, ExistsDir, ExistsFile or Exists.
SERVER
Required for Open. FTP server name or address. Other actions may also give SERVER instead of CONNECTION, in which case a temporary connection is opened and closed around the operation.
USERNAME
Optional, default "anonymous". Login name.
PASSWORD
Optional. Login password.
PORT
Optional, default "21". FTP control port.
CONNECTION
Optional. Name of the connection. Give it with Open and use the same name in later calls in the same request.
TIMEOUT
Optional, default "30". Seconds to wait for each reply.
STOPONERROR
Optional, default "Yes". Yes throws an Application exception when an operation fails. No just sets CFFTP.Succeeded to NO and carries on.
DIRECTORY
Required for ChangeDir, CreateDir, RemoveDir, ListDir, ExistsDir. Remote directory.
NAME
Required for ListDir. Query that receives the listing: Name, Path, URL, Length, LastModified, Attributes, IsDirectory and Mode.
LOCALFILE
Required for GetFile, PutFile. Full path of the file on this server.
REMOTEFILE
Required for GetFile, PutFile, ExistsFile. Name of the file on the FTP server.
ITEM
Required for Remove, Exists. Remote file to delete or test.
EXISTING
Required for Rename. Current remote name.
NEW
Required for Rename. New remote name.
FAILIFEXISTS
Optional, default "Yes". For GetFile: fail if LOCALFILE already exists.
TRANSFERMODE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion always transfers in binary (image) mode.
PASSIVE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion always uses passive mode.
PROXYSERVER
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
RETRYCOUNT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
AGENTNAME
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

After every call, CFFTP.Succeeded is YES or NO, CFFTP.ErrorCode and CFFTP.ErrorText hold the FTP reply when something failed, and CFFTP.ReturnValue holds the answer of GetCurrentDir, ExistsDir, ExistsFile and Exists.

Connections live until the end of the request; any connection you forget to close is closed for you.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Is there an FTP server on this machine? Ask politely with STOPONERROR="No" --->
<CFFTP ACTION="Open" SERVER="127.0.0.1" USERNAME="anonymous" PASSWORD="someone@localhost"
       CONNECTION="Demo" TIMEOUT="10" STOPONERROR="No">
<CFIF CFFTP.Succeeded>
  <CFFTP ACTION="ListDir" CONNECTION="Demo" DIRECTORY="/" NAME="Files" STOPONERROR="No">
  <CFFTP ACTION="Close" CONNECTION="Demo" STOPONERROR="No">
  <CFIF IsDefined("Files")>
    <TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
    <TR><TH>Name</TH><TH>Size</TH><TH>Directory?</TH></TR>
    <CFOUTPUT QUERY="Files">
    <TR><TD>#Name#</TD><TD>#Length#</TD><TD>#IsDirectory#</TD></TR>
    </CFOUTPUT>
    </TABLE>
  </CFIF>
<CFELSE>
  <CFOUTPUT>
  <TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
  <TR><TD>CFFTP.Succeeded</TD><TD>#CFFTP.Succeeded#</TD></TR>
  <TR><TD>CFFTP.ErrorCode</TD><TD>#CFFTP.ErrorCode#</TD></TR>
  <TR><TD>CFFTP.ErrorText</TD><TD>#CFFTP.ErrorText#</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
  </CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>
